sub_graphs.title: Gloas Fork Choice: Dual-Track Payload State Management
sub_graphs.description: Models the dual-track consensus mechanism that separates consensus block validation from execution payload availability tracking

nodes.label: Consensus Block Received
nodes.description: A new signed beacon block has been received by the fork choice

nodes.label: Process on_block
nodes.description: Construct parent state from execution_payload_states (full parent) or block_states (empty parent) and process the block

nodes.label: Payload Status Pending
nodes.description: Block has been processed for consensus but execution payload has not yet been received or verified

nodes.label: Payload Status Empty
nodes.description: Block is valid for consensus purposes without the execution payload (empty track)

nodes.label: Process on_execution_payload
nodes.description: Process execution envelope, verify data availability, update execution_payload_states

nodes.label: Payload Status Full
nodes.description: Block has both consensus validity and a verified execution payload

nodes.label: Compute Fork Choice Head
nodes.description: Run fork choice with payload status tiebreaker to determine the canonical chain head

edges.label: Full payload block considered for head
Empty payload block considered for head

external_entities.name: Execution Layer
external_entities.description: The execution client providing the execution payload envelope

sub_graphs.title: Gloas Fork Choice: Payload Timeliness Committee (PTC) Voting
sub_graphs.description: Models the PTC voting mechanism that determines payload timeliness and influences fork choice

nodes.label: PTC Committee Assigned for Slot
nodes.description: A committee of validators has been assigned PTC duty for the current slot

nodes.label: Check Payload Timeliness
nodes.description: Evaluate is_payload_timely: PTC vote must exceed 256 affirmative votes AND payload exists in execution_payload_states

nodes.label: Process on_payload_attestation_message
nodes.description: Update ptc_vote boolean vector by validator index within the assigned committee

nodes.label: PTC Quorum Reached
nodes.description: More than 256 out of 512 PTC members have voted affirmatively for payload presence

nodes.label: PTC Quorum Not Reached
nodes.description: Insufficient PTC votes; payload is not considered timely

nodes.label: Apply Payload Status Tiebreaker
nodes.description: Use get_payload_status_tiebreaker to decide between FULL and EMPTY states for competing chains

external_entities.name: PTC Committee Validator
external_entities.description: A validator assigned to the Payload Timeliness Committee, submitting payload attestation messages

sub_graphs.title: Gloas Fork Choice: Proposer Boost Conditions
sub_graphs.description: Models the conditions under which proposer boost is applied, including equivocation detection

nodes.label: Block Proposed in Current Slot
nodes.description: A new block has been proposed for the current slot

nodes.label: Check Parent Block Slot
nodes.description: Determine if parent block is from a previous slot or non-previous slot

nodes.label: Check Weight Threshold
nodes.description: If parent is from previous slot, check if parent achieved sufficient weight threshold

nodes.label: Check for Early Equivocations
nodes.description: Verify no early equivocations exist from the same proposer

nodes.label: Proposer Boost Applied
nodes.description: The proposed block receives proposer boost weight in fork choice

nodes.label: Proposer Boost Denied
nodes.description: The proposed block does not receive proposer boost due to failed conditions

external_entities.name: Block Proposer
external_entities.description: The validator proposing the block that may receive proposer boost

ambiguities.text: The term 'sufficient weight threshold' for proposer boost conditions is not precisely quantified in the fork choice description.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the weight threshold follows the existing proposer boost percentage from the base fork choice specification (e.g., 40% committee weight). This needs verification against the full Gloas spec.

ambiguities.text: The specification mentions 'early equivocations' without defining the precise time boundary between early and late equivocations.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume 'early' refers to equivocations detected before the attestation deadline within the slot. This aligns with the timeliness index structure.

ambiguities.text: The behavior when on_block constructs parent state and the parent has both execution_payload_states and block_states entries is not fully specified for edge cases.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume execution_payload_states takes priority over block_states when both exist for the same parent block hash, as FULL state subsumes EMPTY state.

implicit_assumptions.description: PTC committee members are assumed to honestly report payload presence based on their actual observation.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: A colluding PTC majority (>256 of 512) could falsely attest to payload presence or absence, manipulating fork choice between FULL and EMPTY tracks.

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot control a majority of PTC committee validators for a given slot.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Attacker could force the chain to follow the EMPTY track even when payloads are available, or force FULL track for unavailable payloads.

implicit_assumptions.description: The execution payload envelope arrives within the PTC deadline for honest proposers.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Honest proposers' blocks may be penalized to EMPTY status due to network delays, giving an advantage to well-connected attackers.

implicit_assumptions.description: The slot-based latest message tracking (replacing epoch-based) does not introduce additional memory or computational overhead that could be exploited.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Potential denial-of-service if tracking per-slot messages significantly increases state size, especially over long non-finality periods.
